changes.change: Parameter "Enable Error Detection and Status Reporting" has been added
When Error Detection and Status Reporting is enabled, a conduit interface with two output ports indicating ECC status and ECC source is added to the core
Instruction and data manager interfaces on the core have been updated to use AXI4Lite interface instead of AXI4 interface
Support added for Error Detection and Status Reporting for internal core memories
Options added to select between a pipeline or non-pipelined processor architecture. Atomics EXT support is disabled when the processor architecture is configured to be non-pipelined architecture
Bug case which resulted in incorrect values of registers when read in debug mode has been fixed
Performance/Area optimization- Instruction decoder, ALU, shifter

changes.change: We have added a new Parameter EN_SYS_PLL (Enable System PLL for F-Tile).
We have enabled PTP_TX_CLASSIFIER_ENABLE(Enable Tx PTP Classifier) for MAC Segmented Variants in F Tile.
We have added a new Parameter PORTx_FLOW_CONTROL_EN (Enable SFC/PFC Queue Buffering).
We have added a new Parameter PORTx_PFC_NUM_QUEUES (Number Of Queues).
We have added a new Parameter PORTx_PFC_TX_QUEUEy_SIZE (TX Queue Size).
We have added a new Parameter PORTx_PFC_RX_QUEUEy_SIZE (RX Queue Size).
We have enabled ANLT support with Dynamic Reconfiguration for F Tile.
We have enabled Preamble Pass through support with Dynamic Reconfiguration for F Tile.(Except 40G and 50G)
A new input port i_clk_sys will be added whenever user disables the parameter EN_SYS_PLL.
Added these new ports when PFC is enabled:- pX_tx_pfc_watermark,pX_rx_pfc_stall
We have enabled Dynamic Reconfiguration feature for F-Tile.
F Tile is provided as Early access.
SFC/PFC Queue Buffering feature is added for FTile.
